scope: Separate review of selected graph implications and quoted evidence. Source hashes and quotation matches checked separately. Not human adjudication or exhaustive historical verification.

findings.target: F2 and reading.md statement that Yose never met or heard the men
findings.reason: The saved quotation asks whether he had heard this teaching. Penei Moshe treats it as a surprised rhetorical question; Ohr LaYesharim reads lack of knowledge of the prayer wording. Neither says he never met these people or never heard anything from them. Do not add either a contact edge or a negative lifetime contact edge. Keep the narrator question and each interpretation.

Keep the printed joins and the attributed reconstruction as separate readings. A generation number alone does not prove a citation impossible: generations may overlap and a senior may cite a junior. The identity and typography assumptions need their own evidence and cannot validate each other.
These are reports of manuscript readings and later changes in a commentary. No manuscript was directly inspected. Keep the reported witness, corrector and proposed emendation distinct.
